newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar, pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee traded weaker against both the dollar and the sterling pound on Tuesday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 20.9295 to the dollar from 20.865 on Monday, and at 34.8665 to the pound from 34.727.
Forex dealers said dollar and pound continued strengthening on international markets.
"The central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday mid afternoon at the prevailing interbank rate," one dealer said.
